premises.text: Email is the workplace default and should be enhanced rather than replaced
premises.evidence_span: we don't think the answer is to throw email away. We don't think that works

premises.text: The Loop is an email-native smart list plus SaaS that is easy to create, search, share, and follow without changing user behavior
premises.evidence_span: We don't ask for behavior changes, because it's just email

premises.text: Intrinsic email-list virality plus freemium paid customization, admin, and integrations
premises.evidence_span: email lists are just intrinsically viral, which is part of what got us interested in the idea in the first place

value.text: More productive, collaborative, social workplace email with high adoption
value.evidence_span: make email more productive, so you waste less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

notes: Merged market and product into one email-native theory domain; commercial freemium kept separate. Truncation flagged.
